candidate.title: Repli-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Repli-Seq schematic: BrdU labeling of newly replicating DNA, cell sorting/lysis, anti-BrdU bead capture, the combined Elute / End Repair block, and purification to DNA. One generic route is drawn; no alternative workflow or explicit fraction branches are depicted. The RNA/run-on labels in the left panels are preserved in the evidence and corrected explicitly using the cited Hansen primary paper. Its six-fraction implementation resolves the temporal association without adding six drawn branches: G1b, S1, S2, S3, S4 and G2 sample the DNA synthesis interval, rather than six independent phases covering the entire cell cycle. Fractions are kept separate for library construction. The drawn endpoint is purified nascent genomic DNA, not an adapter-ligated sequencing library. The card reports a subsequent TruSeq DNA preparation interface; that component is not another method target and its internal operations are unshown. The primary paper supports the labeling, fractionation, capture and readout interpretation, without establishing that its complete library protocol is identical to the catalogue TruSeq interface or resolving the drawn end-repair chemistry.
